title: Pap, chicken and cabbage
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Pull the skin off the drumsticks, season them with salt, pepper and paprika and roast for 35 to 40 minutes, turning once, until the juices run clear and there is no pink at the bone.
For stiff pap, bring salted water to the boil, about twice the volume of the maize meal. Stir the maize meal in bit by bit with a wooden spoon so no lumps form.
Cover and steam on low for 20 minutes, stirring firmly every 5 minutes, until thick and smooth.
Shred the cabbage and chop the tomato. Fry them in the oil over medium heat with a splash of water for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring, until soft, then season with salt and pepper.
Serve the pap with the chicken and cabbage.
